title: Dog Rubber Chew Toys Cute Bone Shape Teeth Cleaning And Grinding Soft Puppy Teething Chew Toys For Small Medium Dogs Pink
body_html: 1、RUBBER MATERIAL: Puppy teething toys are made of rubber, soft and durable for pets to chew, safe and harmless for puppies, durable and resistance to bite. 2、TEETH CLEANING: Dog rubber chew toys can help puppies clean their teeth, guard them from oral diseases, and also help them grow white and healthy teeth. 3、TEETH GRINDING: Dog rubber chew toys have soft particles and teething bumps on the surface to help relieve itching and provide a comforting massage for their teeth during teething. 4、CUTE SHAPE: Puppy teething toys are designed with a cute shape in the shape of a bone, the cute design is easy to arouse the strong interest of pets, suitable for dogs to chew and play. 5、WIDELY APPLICABLE, EASY TO CLEAN: Dog rubber chew toys are suitable for small and medium sized dogs, making pets happy outdoors or indoors. Easy to clean and care, can be washed and used repeatedly.Item Type: Dog Rubber Chew ToysMaterial: RubberUse: Pet Teeth Cleaning Rubber Toys1 x Dog Rubber Chew Toys
